title: On the minimum vertex cover of snarks
summary: A vertex cover of a graph $G$ is a subset of vertices $C \subseteq V(G)$ such that every edge of $G$ is incident to at least one vertex in $C$. The vertex cover number of $G$ is the minimum cardinality of a vertex cover of $G$ and is denoted by $τ(G)$. A snark is a connected, bridgeless, cubic graph that has an edge chromatic number of four, meaning its edges cannot be properly colored with only three colors.
